name: Standard, grounded vendor-endpoint catalog across every /data source
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-08. Generalize the data/black_diamond/API/ catalog pattern (stood up this session, COO-directed, for the Cottonwood mgmt-fee investigation) into a STANDING organizational process -- the canonical mandatory structure for every /data/{source}/API/ (Orion, Eclipse, SmartX, Schwab, future). MOTIVATION: uncataloged vendor knowledge produced a real WRONG CONCLUSION this session ('no BD billing query type exists', overturned only because Andrew pushed); Orion shows the same ingredients (real probe scripts uncataloged, a parallel billing-dim investigation undiscoverable). The BD catalog proved the value (structured domains/endpoints/payloads/741-field-dictionary made the wrong conclusion fast to correct + the $1M mgmt-fee finding legible/reusable). 2 VARIANTS: REST-vendor (BD/SmartX/Orion -- domains/endpoints/payloads/dictionary) + file-feed (Schwab -- dictionary/schema, no endpoint catalog). Plus: the discovery-methodology playbook (bundle-grep + HAR-capture + roster-is-a-floor), firm-sep for shared tools (no firm defaults -- the commit-gate caught bd_endpoint_sweep.py this session), the grounding+errata correction discipline. Documentation + organizational-process project. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_ENDPOINTS_PRD.md.
phase: PHASE 0 -- PRD CTO-authored 2026-07-08 (Andrew-direct, off DS~A's proposal brief docs/briefs/nfra-endpoints-prd-proposal-20260708.md + the data/black_diamond/API/ reference instance). Awaiting COO decomposition. THE CONVENTION: 2 variants CTO-ratified per vendor -- REST-vendor (README+AUTHENTICATION+domains/{domain}/DOMAIN.md+endpoints/README.md+endpoints/payloads/field_dictionary+tools/+findings/) + file-feed (Schwab's dictionary/schema pattern, no endpoint catalog). Plus the discovery playbook (bundle-grep JS/webpack for routes + live HAR capture+parse + roster-is-a-floor-not-a-ceiling), firm-sep-no-defaults for shared tools (NEVER#1), the grounded-claims + errata-correction discipline (a correction notes the superseded claim + why it existed, not silent-delete). SEQUENCING: Orion FIRST (highest value -- probe scripts uncataloged) -> SmartX retrofit (lowest effort) -> Eclipse stand-up (zero today, D3 open question) -> Schwab assess (file-feed variant, explicit CTO call).
blocking: None to the PRD. COO decomposition + GO (recommend the data-pipeline lane, base COO). Per-vendor TOs: Orion (1st, DS~A available) / SmartX retrofit / Eclipse stand-up / Schwab assess. CTO arch-gates the convention + the variant-per-vendor call + each catalog's completeness (grounded not assumed); CVO certs the catalog claims are real captures (roster-is-a-floor honesty). 3 open decisions (SS12): Schwab variant / field-dictionary depth bar / catalog-to-runtime-graph.
